purpose: Evidence requirements for a production release; automated fixtures do not certify physical devices or full playthroughs.

requirements.description: Ready title cards remain reachable at desktop, portrait and landscape sizes.
requirements.spot_check: Load a fresh profile, wait for readiness, open and cancel each route. Check buttons at rendered hit targets.

requirements.description: Start Day, use the standup and workstation, then reload and Continue with saved state intact.
requirements.spot_check: Clock in, assign the queue, open MUSIC, return to the workstation and reload. Continue must show the same checkpoint with no hidden modal.

requirements.description: Interrupted standalone Night resumes a durable world without changing the campaign save.
requirements.spot_check: Move in standalone Night, open Run Menu, reload, then Resume Night. Compare position, health, district, enemies, rewards and campaign save.

requirements.description: Solo and local co-op selection survives cancellation and enforces keyboard capability.
requirements.spot_check: Cancel and reopen the selector. Touch alone must explain why local co-op is unavailable; a trusted keyboard event may enable it. Enter the three prologue scenes.

requirements.description: Missing codec remains visible until deliberate idempotent Skip.
requirements.spot_check: Force both capability probes false. No src or narrative completion may occur. Double Skip and late Escape must commit exactly once.

requirements.description: Actual iPhone Safari and Android Chrome pass touch, rotation, background/resume, safe-area and audio-unlock acceptance.
requirements.spot_check: On each named physical device complete Day opening, Night restart/resume and Good Dogs prologue. Rotate twice, lock/unlock, switch apps, reopen browser and verify audio plus usable controls.

requirements.description: All nine retained MP4 assets decode in shipping browsers; eight are active routes and retired GD_CUT_03 is decode-only.
requirements.spot_check: Record browser/OS and all nine manifest filenames/digests. Observe advancing decoded frames for each asset; exercise pause/resume and Skip on active routes. GD_CUT_03 stays retired. Capability claims alone do not pass.

requirements.description: Complete intended release routes without seeded state, API progression or test assistance.
requirements.spot_check: Retain input recording, terminal narrative state and save/reload checkpoints. Both local players use independent controls. Record every blocker and retry.

requirements.description: Target devices sustain playable frame pacing, memory and thermal behavior through long sessions.
requirements.spot_check: Run at least 30 minutes per device through combat, scene changes and videos; record frame percentiles, peak memory where exposed, visible stalls and thermal observations.

requirements.description: The candidate tree has passing required remote checks with branch protection independently verified.
requirements.spot_check: Bind check runs to the exact candidate SHA, retain check names, and verify required contexts through branch protection/rulesets. A permissions failure is unverified, never absent.
